title: China’s mysterious new stealth aircraft are likely bombers
description: The breakneck modernisation of China’s air force is a huge threat to Taiwan, as these two new stealth bomber prototypes show.

title: Taiwan Probes Allegations of China's Political Influence on Youth
description: Taiwan's Mainland Affairs Council is investigating claims from a video alleging China's political influence on young Taiwanese, encouraging them to apply for Chinese ID cards. The video details tactics including fostering Taiwanese entrepreneurs and influencing through organizations, raising concerns over potential impacts on national stability.

title: Xi Jinping Honors Jimmy Carter's Historic Role in China-U.S. Relations
description: Xi Jinping expressed condolences over Jimmy Carter’s death, recognizing his pivotal role in establishing China-U.S. diplomatic relations. Carter's tenure helped normalize bilateral ties, shaping modern geopolitics despite ongoing tensions, especially over Taiwan. His legacy includes the 1979 U.S.-China Science and Technology Agreement, significantly impacting both nations’ cooperation.

title: Jimmy Carter: A Diplomatic Legacy Remembered in China-U.S. Relations
description: China expressed deep condolences over the death of Jimmy Carter, acknowledging his crucial role in establishing diplomatic relations with the U.S. Carter, who passed away at 100, was pivotal in strengthening ties between China and the U.S., despite subsequent tensions over the One-China policy and Taiwan.

title: Taiwan's New Legal Crusade Against Forced Organ Harvesting
description: Taiwanese lawmakers have introduced a tough new bill targeting forced organ harvesting. It proposes life imprisonment or the death penalty for offenders, addressing crimes perpetrated by syndicates on vulnerable individuals. The bill enforces stringent penalties, aiming to curb this human rights violation prevalent in some countries, including China.

title: Jimmy Carter and China: Former US president for establishing diplomatic ties, at Taiwan’s expense
description: Former US President Jimmy Carter, who died Sunday at the age of 100, is remembered in China for bringing an end to decades of hostility and establishing diplomatic relations with Beijing – at the expense of Taiwan.

title: Chinese Forces Intensify Patrols Near Scarborough Shoal
description: Chinese naval and air forces executed combat readiness patrols near the Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea. The move aims to bolster control and safeguard national sovereignty and security in the region, underscoring China's firm stance on territorial issues, as stated by the PLA Southern Theater Command.

title: China sanctions US companies over military sales, aid to Taiwan, will it impact Washington?
description: China has decided to put sanctions on US companies after Washington decided to sale weapons to Taiwan. Earlier, Joe Biden had approved military assistance to Taiwan.

title: China sanctions US-linked companies over arms sales to Taiwan
description: The US recently approved $571.3 million in defence support for Taiwan, after giving the go-ahead to arms sales worth an estimated $385 million.

title: China imposes sanctions on military companies, executives over U.S. arms sales to Taiwan
description: Boeing subsidiary Insitu Inc., RTX Inc.’s Raytheon Canada and Raytheon Australia, as well as Hudson Technologies Co. are among the companies listed by China’s foreign ministry
